symptom: Material Powerhouse work could be described as complete at merge, deploy, dispatch, publication or provider acceptance while business outcome, realized value, calibration or the next decision still lacked observed evidence.
root_cause: Technical delivery state and closed-loop business outcome state were not explicitly enforced as one canonical evidence progression across agents, chats, content, sales, growth and portal intelligence.
fix: Make the existing Powerhouse continuity contract require the evidence-backed lifecycle signal → analysis → prediction → decision → execution → provider_readback → outcome → realized_value → calibration → next_decision, while keeping missing evidence explicitly open instead of inferring success.
prevention: Merge, deploy, dispatch, publication and provider acceptance are intermediate states.
Every material stage requires evidence and stage progression remains contiguous and idempotent.
Predicted or expected value is never promoted to realized value without observed evidence.
Missing evidence remains open, blocked, outcome_pending or calibration_pending.
Machine truth remains Supabase; GitHub carries reproducible contract; Portal and Notion remain projections.
